plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, retells a story from American Cosmic, a book by the writer Diana Pasulka. In it, a man named Tim Taylor, a NASA mission controller who also works at the Aerospace Corporation, a space research firm, tells her openly that he is part of a secret space program. Michels says Taylor then took her and a Stanford professor, Garry Nolan, to a UFO crash site where they examined material.
